findings.current: Or when he had ignored his mildly aching stomach, stood guard, and dozed off?
findings.defect: The coordination makes standing guard and dozing off separate sequential actions, while the source says he accidentally fell asleep while on guard duty.
findings.rationale: The construction 호법을 서다 깜빡 졸았던 것 directly links the lapse to his ongoing guard duty.
findings.replacement: Or when he had ignored his mildly aching stomach and accidentally dozed off while standing guard?
findings.source: 아니면 살살 아려 오는 배를 무시하고 호법을 서다 깜빡 졸았던 것?

findings.current: You’re a thousand-year dung beetle that looks like Mimi!
findings.defect: The draft changes the invented dung-themed snake into a beetle, breaking Cheongpung’s comparison to Mimi and the parody of Mimi’s species name.
findings.rationale: 똥각사 is a scatological spoof of the horned-snake terminology associated with Mimi, not a dung beetle.
findings.replacement: You’re a Thousand-Year Dung-Horned Snake that looks just like Mimi!

findings.current: Still, the building had not collapsed, so everyone seemed to be busy cleaning up the mess.
findings.defect: The causal connector says people were busy because the building had not collapsed. The source contrasts the limited damage with how busy everyone nevertheless appeared.
findings.rationale: 그렇다고 … 것도 아니라 establishes a concessive contrast, not the cause expressed by “so.”
findings.replacement: It wasn’t as though the building had collapsed, but everyone still seemed busy dealing with the aftermath.
findings.source: 그렇다고 건물이 무너진 것도 아니라 다들 수습에 바쁜 모양이었다.

findings.current: Hyuk Mujin answered in a trembling voice.
findings.defect: The draft replaces a tearful, near-crying delivery with generic physical trembling.
findings.rationale: 울먹거리다 specifically means speaking as though about to cry.
findings.replacement: Hyuk Mujin answered in a tear-choked voice.

findings.defect: The vocative 형님 is flattened to the literal English kinship term, losing the junior-to-senior form of address and violating the established handling of spoken 형.
findings.rationale: Hyuk Mujin comically escalates through deferential forms of address; “Hyung” preserves the first relational appeal.

findings.current: “C-Could you bring one now? By then, it might have dried!”
findings.defect: Because the preceding singular noun is the attendant, “bring one” appears to ask the man to fetch an attendant, whereas 가져다 주다 asks him to bring the needed cleaning supplies or clothing himself.
findings.rationale: The request contrasts immediate material help with merely passing word to an attendant later.
findings.replacement: “C-Couldn’t you bring me something right now? It might have dried by the time an attendant comes!”
findings.source: “지, 지금 가져다 주면 안 되겠소? 그때가 되면 말라 버릴 수도 있단 말이오.”

findings.defect: The draft changes Jin Taekyung’s deadpan first-person remark into a third-person exclamation, altering both speaker perspective and subject.
findings.rationale: 나 is explicitly first person; the clipped line is Jin’s self-announcing response to being recognized.

findings.defect: The draft replaces the peer-oriented martial address 도우 with the deferential title “Great Hero,” changing the relationship and speech hierarchy.
findings.rationale: 진 도우 addresses Jin as a fellow practitioner, not as 대협.
findings.source: “무, 무슨 일 때문에 그러시오. 진 도우.”

findings.current: Now that I thought about it, Ju Hwaran seemed to have a surprisingly short fuse.
findings.defect: “Short fuse” characterizes Ju Hwaran as quick to anger, but the source only jokes that she seems impatient or hasty after repeatedly cutting Hak Woo off.
findings.rationale: 성격이 급하다 denotes impatience or haste here; Ju Hwaran displays no anger in the exchange.
findings.replacement: Come to think of it, Ju Hwaran seemed surprisingly impatient.
findings.source: 지금 보니 주화란은 은근히 성격이 급한 모양이다.

findings.current: As Kunlun Cloud Dragon Hak Woo vanished, looking as though he might burst into tears, my gaze naturally shifted to the two people who had yet to be dealt with.
findings.defect: The draft omits Hak Woo looking back and forth between Jin Taekyung and Ju Hwaran, a concrete action that completes the comic rejection beat.
findings.rationale: 나와 주화란을 번갈아 바라보던 explicitly describes his alternating gaze before he leaves.
findings.replacement: Kunlun Cloud Dragon Hak Woo looked back and forth between Ju Hwaran and me with eyes on the verge of tears before disappearing, and my gaze naturally shifted to the two people I had yet to deal with.
findings.source: 눈물이라도 뚝뚝 떨어질 것 같은 눈으로 나와 주화란을 번갈아 바라보던 곤륜운룡 학우가 사라지자, 아직 처리하지 못한 두 사람에게 자연히 시선이 쏠렸다.

findings.current: I did not know which sect he belonged to, but I would have wagered my wrist that he had already eaten through several pillars’ worth of food money.
findings.defect: The draft changes the wagered body part from Hyuk Mujin’s wrist to Jin Taekyung’s own wrist. It also recasts the pillar metaphor as a literal quantity of food money.
findings.rationale: 혁무진 손목 explicitly makes Hyuk Mujin’s wrist the stake, while 기둥 몇 개는 뽑았다 jokes that feeding the giant has financially stripped several pillars from his sect.
findings.replacement: I didn’t know which sect he belonged to, but I’d bet Hyuk Mujin’s wrist that this bastard’s food bill had already cost it a few foundation pillars.
findings.source: 사문이 어디인지는 몰라도 이놈 식비로 기둥 몇 개는 뽑았다는 것에 혁무진 손목을 걸 수도 있다.

summary: Two critical subject/object errors, plus actionable losses in humor, hierarchy, characterization, action timing, and pragmatic detail.
